newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says to consider DKB steps after report.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says to consider DKB steps after report.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will consider what measures to take against Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) for hiding loans it made to racketeers from central bank inspectors once the DKB submits a report on the case, the BOJ governor said on Wednesday.

The governor, Yasuo Matsushita, said the central bank had received an explanation from DKB on June 4 but had asked the bank to submit a more detailed report of its internal investigation into the affair.
"We will consider the appropriate measures after seeing the results of the report," he told a news conference.
He did not say when the DKB report might be submitted.
